title: Back Room
cmd_help: Back-room card rooms: place doormen, pick doors, draw the room (admin)
cmd_test_help: Set a back room's time left (free, for testing the warnings and kick-out)
cmd_test_room: Room id (optional: the room you're in, else the nearest doorman)
test_no_room: No back room here: stand in one, near a doorman (%.0f m), or give the room id.
test_bad_minutes: Minutes must be more than 0 and at most %d.
target_bribe: Slip the doorman a few coins
menu_option_desc: One payment opens the door for everyone. Dirty money first.
menu_option_full: That would keep the room open longer than the house allows.
menu_open_for: The room is open for another %s
paid_open: You paid $%s. The door is open for %d minutes.
paid_extend: You paid $%s for %d more minutes. %d minutes left in all.
no_money: The doorman wants $%s and you don't have it.
too_far: You're too far from the doorman.
law_blocked: "Never seen a back room in my life, Sheriff."
too_long: The house won't keep the room open that long (%d minutes already paid).
enter_left: The room is yours for another %s.
warn_minutes: The doorman says the room closes in %d minutes.
warn_seconds: Room closes in %d seconds. Finish your hand!
shown_out: Time's up. The doorman shows you out.
closed_by_admin: The room has been closed. The doorman shows you out.
reup_hint: Tap [%s] for another length, hold [%s] to pay the doorman
reup_full: The house won't keep the room open any longer.
reup_too_late: Too late, the room is already closing.
reup_not_inside: You have to be in the room to pay from here.
reup_by_other: %s paid for %d more minutes. %d minutes left.
admin_new_desc: Make the doors in /doorlock first (locked, no jobs).
admin_editor_sub: Red lines: room zone. Green: kick-out point. Yellow: doorman. Blue: doors.
admin_npc_desc: Place the doorman with the gizmo.
admin_doors_desc: Pick the rsg-doorlock locks the bribe opens.
admin_doors_sub: Enter toggles a door, Backspace goes back
admin_no_doors_desc: Create the doors with /doorlock first: locked, no jobs.
admin_corner_add: Add zone corner where I stand (%d)
admin_corner_desc: Walk the room's corners in order. Players inside the zone are shown out at closing time.
admin_height_desc: Left/right. The floor is just under the lowest corner.
admin_exit_desc: Stand outside the room where shown-out players should end up, facing the way they should face.
admin_test_desc: Opens the room free for %d seconds (save first).
admin_close_desc: Locks the doors and shows everyone out.
admin_delete_desc: Removes the room and its doorman. The rsg-doorlock doors stay.
err_invalid: Something in that room is invalid.
err_model: That isn't a valid ped model.
err_doors: Too many doors for one room.
err_zone: The zone needs 3 or more corners (and not too many).
err_incomplete: A room needs a doorman, a door, 3 zone corners and a kick-out point before it can be enabled.
err_exit_inside: The kick-out point is inside the room zone.
